title: Initialize the project structure
description: Create the project folders and organize HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JSON files. Prepare the main pages and shared assets.
userStories: As a developer, I want an organized project structure so that I can maintain and develop the application easily.
acceptanceCriteria: The project contains index.html, new-project.html and project.html.
CSS, JavaScript and data folders are created.
All HTML pages load without errors.

title: Create the shared application layout
description: Implement the common header, PLANIT AI logo, navigation links and responsive layout using Tailwind CSS.
userStories: As a user, I want consistent navigation so that I can move between the dashboard and project creation pages.
acceptanceCriteria: The header displays the PLANIT AI logo.
Dashboard and Nouveau projet links navigate to the correct pages.
The layout is responsive on desktop and mobile.

title: Build the dashboard interface
description: Create the dashboard displaying project cards with project names, descriptions, total tasks, completed tasks, remaining tasks and progress bars.
userStories: As a user, I want to see all my projects so that I can monitor their progress.
As a user, I want to see project statistics so that I can understand the current development status.
acceptanceCriteria: Project cards display the project name and description.
Each card displays total, completed and remaining tasks.
Each card displays a progress bar.
An empty state appears when no projects exist.
A button allows users to create a new project.

title: Build the project creation form
description: Create the project form containing project name, description, complete brief, duration, developer count, technologies and difficulty level.
userStories: As a user, I want to enter my project information so that I can generate a development plan.
acceptanceCriteria: All required project fields are displayed.
The difficulty selector contains Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced.
The duration and developer count accept integer values greater than or equal to one.
The form is responsive and accessible.

title: Implement real-time form validation
description: Validate the project creation form using JavaScript input and submit events. Display individual error messages and disable submission while the form is invalid.
userStories: As a user, I want immediate validation feedback so that I can correct errors before generating my plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Required fields cannot be empty.
Duration and developer count must be valid positive integers.
Error messages appear below invalid fields.
Errors disappear when fields become valid.
The submit button remains disabled while the form is invalid.

title: Implement AI prompt generation and API integration
description: Build a dynamic prompt using the project information and the required JSON task structure. Send the prompt to the AI API using Fetch and handle the response.
userStories: As a user, I want AI to analyze my project brief so that I can receive an organized development plan.
acceptanceCriteria: The prompt contains all submitted project information.
The prompt requests valid JSON output.
The API request uses Fetch.
Successful responses are received and processed.
API errors are handled without crashing the application.

title: Implement AI response parsing and validation
description: Parse the AI response into a JavaScript object and validate project information, mandatory task fields, allowed values, unique identifiers, dependencies, deadlines and estimated workload before displaying or saving the plan.
userStories: As a user, I want the generated plan to be validated so that I can work with reliable and consistent tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: The AI response is parsed as valid JSON.
All mandatory task properties are checked.
Priority, importance, size and status values are validated.
Task IDs are unique.
Dependencies reference existing task IDs.
Deadlines do not exceed project duration.
Invalid plans are rejected with a clear error message.

title: Implement generation states and retry handling
description: Create the generation interface with idle, loading, success and error states. Prevent duplicate requests and provide a retry option when generation fails.
userStories: As a user, I want to see the generation status so that I know whether my plan is being processed successfully.
acceptanceCriteria: The idle state displays the generation button.
The loading state displays a spinner.
The generation button is disabled during loading.
The success state redirects to the project Task Board.
The error state displays a clear message.
The retry button allows another generation attempt.
The interface never remains permanently blocked after a failed request.

title: Implement LocalStorage project management
description: Save generated projects and their task data in LocalStorage. Implement project retrieval, project deletion and automatic dashboard updates.
userStories: As a user, I want my projects to be saved so that I can access them after reloading the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated projects are saved in LocalStorage.
Projects are retrieved when the dashboard loads.
Deleting a project requires confirmation.
Deleted projects disappear from the dashboard.
Project information remains available after page reload.

title: Build the Task Board interface
description: Create the project Task Board with project summary information and three Kanban columns: Do, In Progress and Done. Display task cards with their essential information.
userStories: As a user, I want to visualize my tasks in a Kanban board so that I can follow the development workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: The project name, duration and team size are displayed.
Estimated hours and project capacity are displayed.
Progress information is displayed.
The three Kanban columns are visible.
Task cards display ID, title, priority, size, estimated time and deadline.
The board is responsive.

title: Implement task details and editing modal
description: Create a modal that displays complete task information and allows users to modify the title, description, priority, size, deadline and status.
userStories: As a user, I want to view complete task details so that I can understand the work required.
As a user, I want to edit tasks so that I can adapt the generated plan to my needs.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a task card opens its detail modal.
All task properties are displayed.
Editable fields can be modified.
Saving changes updates the Task Board.
Changes remain available after reloading the page.
The modal can be closed without saving changes.

title: Implement task deletion and dependency management
description: Allow task deletion with confirmation and automatically remove deleted task IDs from other tasks' dependency arrays.
userStories: As a user, I want to delete unnecessary tasks so that I can keep my development plan updated.
acceptanceCriteria: Deleting a task requires confirmation.
The deleted task disappears from the board.
Its ID is removed from every other task's dependencies.
Changes are saved in LocalStorage.

title: Implement dependency-based status validation
description: Prevent users from moving a task Done while one or more dependencies are not completed. Display an explanatory message and update project progress based only on task statuses.
userStories: As a user, I want task dependencies to be respected so that tasks are completed in the correct order.
As a user, I want accurate progress statistics so that I can monitor project completion.
acceptanceCriteria: A task cannot become Done if one of its dependencies is not Done.
An explanatory message appears when the operation is rejected.
A task can become Done when all dependencies are Done.
Progress equals the number of Done tasks divided by total tasks.
Progress updates immediately after a valid status change.

title: Implement AI settings and demo mode
description: Create the AI settings modal with a password field for the API key, store the key in sessionStorage and implement demo mode using Fetch to load data/sample-plan.json.
userStories: As a user, I want to configure my AI API key so that I can generate development plans.
As a user, I want to use demo mode so that I can test the application without calling the AI API.
acceptanceCriteria: The settings modal is accessible from the header.
The API key field uses password input type.
The API key is stored in sessionStorage only.
The API key is not stored in LocalStorage.
Demo mode loads sample-plan.json using Fetch GET.
The sample plan passes through the same validation process as AI-generated plans.

title: Perform final testing and application deployment
description: Test the complete application workflow, fix identified bugs, verify responsive behavior and prepare the application for deployment. Document the setup and usage instructions.
userStories: As a user, I want a stable and functional application so that I can manage projects and development plans reliably.
acceptanceCriteria: Project creation and validation work correctly.
AI generation and demo mode work correctly.
Invalid AI responses are rejected.
Project and task modifications persist after reload.
Task dependencies are enforced.
Project deletion and task deletion work correctly.
The application works on desktop and mobile.
No critical JavaScript errors remain.
The application is deployed and basic usage instructions are documented.
